report.title: The Duty to Protect: Can the Failure to Use Defensive Force Become a Grave Moral or Legal Wrong?
report.summary: The failure of a state or competent international institution to halt systematic civilian extermination can constitute both a grave moral wrong and an internationally wrongful act under positive international law, yet fulfilling this protective duty does not confer an unrestricted unilateral right…
